speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
title: Prophets, Seers, and Revelators
session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema spoke about “Prophets, Seers, and Revelators”.

quotes.text: For Saints scattered across the Pacific, having an Apostle of the Lord among them was the chance of a lifetime. Reaching the Apostle meant a long voyage for my grandparents across the largest body of water on the planet to the main island of Tongatapu, but first stopping midway on their home island of Vava‘u. The Pacific is known for its fickle weather patterns, and the week of their trip was no different.
quotes.speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The Wolfgramms sailed into a storm; a journey that should have taken 16 hours to Vava‘u stretched into two and a half brutal days at sea. From my Gramma’s journal, she wrote: “We were completely soaked, … battered, and sick, … too weak to eat. … I held Vilimanulea to my chest until finally arriving to Vava‘u.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: They were sailing toward an Apostle, who held priesthood keys, held the authority for the ordinances that would later seal them as an eternal family. They sailed to sit at the feet of an Apostle, who would teach them their duty so they could bless others on their island with the message of the restored gospel of Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: You see, my grandparents understood that the gospel restored by Joseph Smith revealed truths previously withheld from them. Joseph helped restore the Savior’s Church with prophets, seers, and revelators who held priesthood keys that would one day bind them together as a family forever.
quotes.speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: “Behold, the days come … that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord:
quotes.speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The Lord gave Joseph Smith this counsel: “And all they who receive the oracles of God, let them beware how they hold them lest they are accounted as a light thing” (Doctrine and Covenants 90:5).
quotes.speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: In a general conference address over 20 years ago, President Jeffrey R. Holland asked: “Are the heavens open? Does God reveal His will to prophets and apostles as in days of old? That they are and that He does is the unflinching declaration of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints to all the world. And in that declaration lies the significance of Joseph Smith, the Prophet, for nearly 200 years now” (“ Prophets, Seers, and Revelators,” Liahona, Nov. 2004, 8).
quotes.speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: With that clear, simple, and understated introduction, the Father and His Son, Jesus Christ, would begin the work of restoring the Savior’s ancient Church through a then-teenage boy in upstate New York.
quotes.speaker: Elder Vaiangina Sikahema
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

scriptures.text: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and shall not find it.
Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

And all they who receive the oracles of God, let them beware how they hold them lest they are accounted as a light thing, and are brought under condemnation thereby, and stumble and fall when the storms descend, and the winds blow, and the rains descend, and beat upon their house.

It no sooner appeared than I found myself delivered from the enemy which held me bound. When the light rested upon me I saw two Personages, whose brightness and glory defy all description, standing above me in the air. One of them spake unto me, calling me by name and said, pointing to the other--This is My Beloved Son. Hear Him!

What I the Lord have spoken, I have spoken, and I excuse not myself; and though the heavens and the earth pass away, my word shall not pass away, but shall all be fulfilled, whether by mine own voice or by the voice of my servants, it is the same.
